name: django-run-site
description: Reference for working with a local Django dev stack managed by run-site (django-run-site) and/or django-dev-helpers — how to tell whether the dev server is running, where the .run-site-config sidecar and .dev_helpers_* dotfiles live, how to read the web/Postgres/Redis/SQLite endpoints and ports, how to make an authenticated request via autologin, and what run-site can do
